verdict.rationale: Docs say you can connect your own repository or multiple repositories, and an onboarding agent sets up the codebase, environment variables and setup script automatically. GitHub branch rules, permissions and merge settings carry over out of the box, which suggests low setup friction. However, no evidence describes a one-click install flow for granting repo access (the 'one click' claim refers to skills, not repos), and all evidence is vendor marketing. Missing for 10: documented one-click repo install or GitHub App authorization flow, details on the repo access and permission grant step, independent or hands-on corroboration.
